nom: REUZEL TAT BUFF Gentle Exfoliating Wash

avis.texte: Like this product because it only contains ingredients you need.
Exfoliation works perfectly smell great leaves skin feel awesome
Love this tattoo wash. It gently exfoliates the skin. It pairs well with Reuzel's other tattoo care.
Works really well especially when paired with the shine spray or hydro buff.
Product works great, smells good. Seems to exfoliate as it should and isn't too rough.
All products for tattoos are amazing and I highly recommend them. The cream that's for after care was so much nicer to use and felt on my skin

The exfoliating buff wash is an absolute game changer to my tattoo care routine. Applying just a little bit in the shower definitely helps me remove all that dead skin that just lingers after a long day working my day to day job. Highly recommend it !

avis.titre: Great Scrub, really helps bring my tats back to life.
avis.texte: This is a great scrub, used along with the shine spray it really makes my tats appear more vivid and new again. I like it so much that I'm using it all over, even where I don't have tats.

The Buff Exfoliating Wash I bought for the first time recently. It doesn't dry my skin out and the Bamboo grains are super gentle which is a plus for me. I use a lot of Reuzel products and will definitely be adding Buff Exfoliating Wash to my list of must-haves :).
